title: NYCU Elite Ph.D. Scholarship for New Students
official_source: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), Office of International Affairs, Division of International Talent Cultivation
program_type: University nomination-based doctoral scholarship (college recommendation and scholarship committee review, not a direct student application)
duration: Two years of monthly stipend plus tuition waiver, per NYCU's published 'Scholarship Content and Duration'.
description: The NYCU Elite Ph.D. Scholarship for New Students awards a monthly stipend of NT$33,000 together with a tuition waiver for two years to new doctoral students at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University who have outstanding grades and hold no other scholarship or grant from the Taiwan government. It is not open to direct application: NYCU states that the award is made on the basis of recommendations from the college and a review by the scholarship committee. title: MOE Elite Scholarship Program for Lecturers from South and Southeast Asian and African Countries
official_source: Ministry of Education (MOE), Republic of China (Taiwan)
program_type: Government graduate scholarship for university lecturers from South, Southeast Asia and Africa to study in Taiwan (Ministry of Education, New Southbound Policy talent development)
duration: Up to 2 years for a master's programme and up to 3 years for a doctoral programme under the standard MOE terms, reviewed annually. Some participating universities extend this, and Taipei Tech runs the award for up to 4 years.
description: The MOE Elite Scholarship Program was created by the Ministry of Education of the Republic of China (Taiwan) under its New Southbound Policy to encourage university lecturers from South and Southeast Asian and African countries to pursue graduate degrees in Taiwan, with priority given to doctoral study. title: Excellence Master Fellowships (Faculty of Science, University of Geneva)
program_type: Faculty-level excellence grant scheme for incoming Master of Science students
duration: One year, then extended for the regular duration of the chosen Master's programme (three or four semesters) if academically successful after the first semester
description: The Faculty of Science of the University of Geneva runs an Excellence Fellowship programme, supported by external partners, for students who want to pursue a Master of Science in one of the disciplines covered by the Faculty. The fellowship is a grant of CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 per year with no teaching duties, awarded for one year and extended for the regular duration of the chosen Master's programme if the holder is academically successful at the end of the first semester. title: Unil Master's Scholarship
program_type: University excellence scholarship for international master's admission
duration: The minimum statutory period of the chosen Master's programme
description: The University of Lausanne awards around ten excellence scholarships each year, exclusively to students who have graduated from a foreign university and whose academic results are of a very high standard. The scholarship is paid for the minimum statutory period of the Master's programme at CHF 1,600 per month, and recipients are exempt from the standard course registration fees, with only the CHF 80 semester fees remaining payable. title: Excellence Scholarship for Bachelor Students (University of St.Gallen)
program_type: Merit-based university excellence scholarship, invitation only
duration: Six semesters of Bachelor-level tuition fees (three years)
description: The University of St.Gallen awards Excellence Scholarships to students enrolled in a Bachelor's degree on the basis of merit. The scholarship amount corresponds to the current tuition fees at the Bachelor level for a total of six semesters. It is not open to self-application: the Advice Center for Study Funding identifies enrolled students with an outstanding academic performance in the HSG Assessment Year and invites them to apply. The University of St.Gallen and the Monique Dornonville de la Cour - Stiftung currently fund these Bachelor-level excellence scholarships.

title: Starr International Foundation Scholarship (University of St.Gallen)
program_type: Foundation-funded master's excellence scholarship, delivered through the HSG Best Talents Programme
description: The Starr International Foundation promotes education in Switzerland and abroad, and the HSG Starr International Foundation Fund supports excellence scholarships of the HSG Best Talents Programme. The Best Talents Programme gives financial support, including coverage of tuition fees and contributions to living expenses, alongside a personal development programme for outstanding and engaged bachelor's graduates from EU/EFTA countries or holders of a Swiss C permit who are admitted to a master's at HSG. title: Alfred Werner Scholarship Program (SCS Foundation)
program_type: Industry- and donor-funded master's scholarship, nomination only
duration: Master of Science studies, awarded per admitted cohort (2027-2029 call)
description: The Alfred Werner Scholarship Program of the SCS Foundation, a partner organisation of the Swiss Chemical Society, supports highly talented international students who obtained their BSc outside Switzerland and wish to pursue an MSc in Chemistry, Biochemistry or the Pharmaceutical Sciences at a Swiss university or one of the Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology. The scholarship amounts to CHF 36,000, previously CHF 30,000, and is supported by the Swiss chemical and pharmaceutical industry and private donors.
